full_page.content:
Page 108 Feb. 1st Mrs. Lyla C, Johnson - 39 - goitre after three removals - threatened with 4th fears to go to hospital
1st Baby Dennis Fred 0'Neill - 2 weeks pneumonia - first baby 8 yrs in coming
James Johnson -70 -mental - Dear-hopes - Enrolled To-day 5.00
1 Baby John Sharpe - 3 mo. old pneu.
1 Mrs. Violet Scanlon - Episcopelian - about 30 - Jealous fears insanity Alfred Rivers - 30 - in Herman K. since Monday - Scarlet fever feared. Robert Burke - 46 - missing since a week last Monday Wm. Ford - 57 - strep throat "no hope".
Lafayette Baker - 53 - Convert of 18 yrs. - drinks, etc. Seemingly Cath. for wedding-day only .... Enrolled To-day.
Page 109 Ist Gilbert Sarivce - 6 - mental -
2 Margaret Cummiskey - 42 - lost breast three years ago - now trouble seems coming again.
Mrs. Celia (Duncan) MacDonald of Flint broke both legs about Thanksgiv- ing-d. was enrolled Dec. 21 and since that has been improving. Must be close to fifty-five .... She wants to thank for prayers .... & beg for a continuation ....
Helen Jozwik - 20 - had T. B. now has developed mental weakness Edgar Picard - 6 - bronchitis - sick since six months old.
Baby Mary Ann Jemcik - 12 - has never stood or sat up alone. Parents promise to go back to sacram. - not to confession sice married - 23 yrs. Child enrolled To-day. 1.00
Page 110 Feb. 7 Carolyn Labbe - 5 - defective sight. Drs. say it will not be normal.
8
7 Mrs. Leona Labdie - Wyandotte - 24 - stomach cancer complication, etc. .... in bed now 7 mo. Only a miracle left to hope for - unable to speak - feet and hands -swolen ... Hope ... next Saturday-Our Lady of Lourdes.
